style_identity_approval: D030 locked standard_v1; existing original artwork unchanged
measurement_approval: Agent visual landmark annotations, +/-3 source pixels; quantitative calibration is not new user artwork approval.
definition: Visible upright-head envelope from highest hair tip to chin, normalized by measured standing height. This is NOT traditional anatomical head count.
legacy_measure_warning: measure.json neck_y is the minimum silhouette row inside a search band. For A1 front it lands at y=136, above the observed chin near y=155; its old heads_tall estimate cannot validate proportion consistency.

supporting_camera_reference.use: Matched game camera/pose visual review only; crouched silhouette is not standing height.

policy: Every source batch needs an upright neutral companion at the SAME anatomical pixel scale, with explicit feet and hair/chin landmarks.
Every unique pose needs head landmarks bound to the exact source hash; no per-pose bbox normalization.
Strong head tilt, rear view or occlusion requires separately reviewed projection evidence, never a guessed pass.
A head-size pass is not identity, limb anatomy, motion, weapon, style or runtime approval.
